commitResults.messageTitle: Keep student rows in view under a long message at the minimum window size
commitResults.messageBody:
The result box could grow to 40% of the window, about 150px at 760x400.
With the command box, tabs and table headings fixed above and below it,
that left the student list or calendar no room at all.

Also cap the result at the window height minus 320px, so a short window
scrolls a long message and keeps a few rows of the screen below. Taller
windows keep the 40% share.

Fixes #211

commitResults.messageTitle: Name the newly open student after Alt+Up/Down or a click
commitResults.messageBody:
The result display only changed when a command ran. Alt+Up/Down and
clicking a row open another student's details without a command, so the
result kept naming the student that view had opened.

Show view's message for the newly open student whenever the open
student changes outside a command. Commands that open a student, such
as add and note-add, keep their own message.

Fixes #212

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep "Recent" and the newest command readable in a narrow window
commitResults.messageBody:
The result beside the recent commands is a Text, which never shrinks, so
a narrow row squeezed the "Recent" caption and every chip down to "...",
the newest command included.

Keep the caption at its full width and the newest chip at its full
width up to the usual chip limit, so the older commands are cut short
first.

Fixes #217

commitResults.messageTitle: Put the level under a long name instead of breaking a word
commitResults.messageBody:
At 1024px the Name column could not fit "Montgomery-Fitzgerald" (JavaFX
does not break at hyphens) beside "Secondary", the longest word of the
level. The name then kept only 60% of the cell and broke mid-word as
"Montgomery-Fitzgeral" / "d".

When the longest words of the name and the level cannot sit side by
side, put the level under the name and let each take the whole cell.
The name and level now sit in a FlowPane, which wraps the level to a
second line. The gap allowance grows by 2px because layout rounds each
text up to a whole pixel, which would otherwise wrap a level that fits.

Fixes #218

commitResults.messageTitle: Drop screen headings in short windows instead of cutting the message
commitResults.messageBody:
Capping the result at the window height minus 320px left a 52px box at
760x400. That cut a usage error's Format line in half and hid its
Example and the Tab hint, and still showed no full student row.

Undo that cap, so long messages again get up to 40% of the window.
Make room in short windows by hiding each screen's heading row
("Students 8 students" and Add student, This week, Archives), under the
same rule that already hides the brand and the footer.

Refs #211

commitResults.messageTitle: Drop the oldest recent commands rather than cut off the result
commitResults.messageBody:
Keeping the newest chip at full width meant that a long newest command
and a result near 60 characters no longer fit at 760px, and the result
was clipped mid-word.

When the row is too narrow, hide the oldest commands whole until it
fits. The result is never squeezed, and the newest command is the last
to give way.

Refs #217

commitResults.messageTitle: Stack the level only when that lets the name's longest word fit
commitResults.messageBody:
A name with one word wider than the whole Name column breaks inside
that word wherever the level goes, so putting the level under it only
added a line. Keep such rows side by side, as before, with the name
keeping its share and the level the rest.

Also undo the 2px added to the level gap, which moved wrapped names and
their levels by up to 2px at normal sizes. Instead let the name and
level run 2px past the cell, as the old layout did, so pixel rounding
no longer wraps a level that fits.

Guard that a typical name and level, such as "Alice Tan" and
"Secondary 3", stay on one line.

Refs #218
